title: Aquatic therapy compared to standard care for chronic low back pain: a randomized controlled trial
comparison_or_design: The analyzed aquatic-therapy comparison in chronic low back pain.
observations_or_assays: Combined HADS psychological score (not separate anxiety/depression subscales)
excluded: Other psychological, sleep and quality-of-life measures
Parent-trial muscle morphology, other visits and subgroup analyses
Separate HADS anxiety/depression subscale results and other psychological measures
population_or_material: The analyzed chronic-low-back-pain cohort in this two-arm aquatic-therapy trial.
requested_items: Table 3 NPRS, ODI and combined HADS outcome: adjusted baseline/week-10 arm means, within-arm changes, week-10 group comparisons and group-by-time F with P/df/eta-squared supplements. Exclude SF-12 and other psychological scales.
case_specific_rules: Use the requested adjusted Table 3 outcomes. Preserve a reported between-group MD and its own CI without inferring its subtraction direction from the two adjusted means or the table column order. Keep the task-requested F/df/partial-eta-squared supplements with the corresponding analysis.
